text:
payments-bot: Alert: payment for INV-5012 (Orbital ML) failed - decline code: card_declined. Attempt 1.

rachel_finance: Noted. This is a renewal on an annual enterprise plan. I emailed billing contact earlier but no reply.

dylan_support: Just heard back in the support ticket: customer says their card hit a daily limit and they'd rather send an ACH today. Asked for ACH details and whether we can provision service while ACH is in flight.

rachel_finance: We can accept ACH but per policy we don't mark invoices paid until funds settle. Pause dunning and auto-cancel for 72h. @tom_accounting can you pause dunning and change status to "pending - ACH"?

tom_accounting: Pausing dunning for 72h and setting invoice flag to pending_ach. When they post ACH confirmation (trace id + amount), paste it here and I'll reconcile. If they want immediate provisioning, sales needs to sign off.

meena_sales: AM confirmed they can initiate ACH today if we send details. They're asking for a template to copy into their bank portal.

rachel_finance: ACH template (mask acct):

```
Bank: Pacific Federal Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: ****1122
Routing (ACH/ABA): 333000444
Account type: Checking
Memo/Reference: INV-5012
Amount: USD 45,000.00
Please include invoice number in the memo.
```

Dylan_support: Sent to customer at 09:47 PT with a note: "Reply with ACH trace (or bank confirmation) and approximate settlement date; we'll reconcile immediately when it posts." Included invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-5012

rachel_finance: I scheduled a single card retry in 36h in case they fix the card limit. If ACH confirmation arrives before then I'll cancel the retry.

payments-bot: Scheduled retry: 1746166656 (36h).

meena_sales: Please CC accounting on the customer reply so reconciliation is fast. If ACH doesn't show by EOD+3 escalate to collections.

tom_accounting: Got it. When ACH posts, include bank trace + posted date here. I'll apply payment and close invoice. If they send a partial ACH, AM must approve applying partial credit.

rachel_finance: I'll keep thread open. Thanks, team. :pray:
